name: What causes drywall cracks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall cracks can be caused by various factors, including the natural settling of a house over time, fluctuations in temperature and humidity, and minor seismic activity common in the Bay Area. Poor drywall installation, such as insufficient fasteners or improper joint taping, can also lead to cracks. Larger cracks might indicate structural issues, water damage, or foundation movement, which require immediate professional assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall cracks are typically caused by house settling, temperature changes, seismic activity, or poor installation. Structural issues or water damage can also be factors.
